name: iam:PassRole + cloudformation:CreateStack
description: A principal with iam:PassRole and cloudformation:CreateStack can create a new CloudFormation stack that provisions AWS resources using the permissions of a passed IAM role. When the passed role has administrative permissions, the template can create resources that grant the attacker escalated access — such as a new IAM role with AdministratorAccess that trusts the attacker's principal for sts:AssumeRole.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target CloudFormation service role ARN must be in Resource

additional.description: Clean up the attack stack after exploitation
Discover available CloudFormation-trusted roles to pass

admin: A role must exist that trusts cloudformation.amazonaws.com as a service principal
The role must have administrative permissions (e.g., AdministratorAccess)
lateral: A role must exist that trusts cloudformation.amazonaws.com as a service principal

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation - Rhino Security Labs

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: ARN of the IAM role to pass to CloudFormation (must trust cloudformation.amazonaws.com)

options.name: PAYLOAD
options.description: Payload type for the CloudFormation template (backdoor/attach-policy)

options.name: STACK_NAME
options.description: Name for the CloudFormation stack to create. Auto-generated if not set

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for CloudFormation and IAM operations

options.name: ASSUME_ROLE
options.description: Assume the escalated role after the stack completes

options.name: ESCALATED_ROLE_NAME
options.description: Name for the escalated IAM role to create (auto-generated if empty)

options.name: TRUST_PRINCIPAL
options.description: ARN to trust in the escalated role's trust policy (defaults to caller ARN)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Delete the CloudFormation stack after execution. Requires cloudformation:DeleteStack

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Create an IAM role with AdministratorAccess trusted by the attacker's principal via CloudFormation template
